translation: Zhang Jiegu said: For disease of the Belt Vessel, the Greater Yin governs it; one should moxa the two Zhangmen points, three zhuang. The Plain Questions says: When pathogenic qi lodges in the collateral of the Greater Yin, it causes lower back pain that draws the lower abdomen and pulls at the flank (miao), so that one cannot rest and breathe (miao refers to the empty soft region below the floating rib). Zhang Zhongjing said: After a serious illness has recovered, if there is water-qi below the lower back, the Muli Zexie Powder governs it.
